headline: WESTBRIDGE PACKAGING LIMITED signs distribution tie-up for northern markets
body:
WESTBRIDGE PACKAGING LIMITED has entered into a distribution arrangement covering northern markets, the company said.

Under the arrangement, a regional distributor will handle secondary sales for part of the company's Packaging range. The company said the tie-up would extend its reach without additional fixed costs.

Terms were not disclosed.

headline: Indus Crest commissions new line at Raipur facility
body:
Indus Crest has commissioned an additional production line at its Raipur facility, taking installed capacity higher in the Steel Trading segment.

The company said the line was funded through a mix of internal accruals and a term facility, and would be ramped up over two quarters.

Management said existing customers had indicated demand for the additional volumes.

headline: Mahanadi Inds. scales back operations at Cuttack unit
body:
Mahanadi Inds. has reduced operations at its Cuttack unit, moving to a single shift from three, according to two people with direct knowledge of the decision.

The company has cited weak order inflow in the Chemicals segment. Contract workers engaged at the unit have not been recalled since the end of the previous month.

A former employee said material procurement had also slowed noticeably since the start of the quarter.

The company confirmed a "temporary realignment of production" without giving details.

headline: Workers at Jayanth Inds. plant protest over delayed wages
body:
Workers at the Hosur facility of Jayanth Inds. halted work for part of the day this week over what they described as delays in salary disbursement running to several weeks.

A representative of the works committee said wages for the preceding month had been paid only in part, and that provident fund deductions had been made without corresponding remittance. Management met the committee the same evening and, according to one attendee, sought additional time.

The plant employs a workforce in the low hundreds and supplies Plastics components to customers across western India.

The company declined to comment on the specifics of the dispute.

headline: Vendors say Emberline has fallen behind on payments
body:
Several suppliers to Emberline, the Electrical Equipment firm based in Coimbatore, say invoice settlements have slipped well beyond agreed terms over the past two quarters.

Three vendors, who asked not to be named because they continue to trade with the company, described payment delays of between 60 and 100 days against contractual terms of 45 days. One said part-payments had been offered in place of full settlement on two occasions.

A person familiar with the company's operations said working capital had been "stretched" by slower collections from its own customers. Emberline did not respond to a request for comment.

Trade sources in Coimbatore said the company continued to place fresh orders through the period.

headline: Legal notice served on Arcline Inds. over unpaid dues
body:
A Steel Fabrication trading firm has served a legal notice on Arcline Inds. seeking recovery of dues it says have been outstanding for more than six months.

The notice, a copy of which was reviewed, relates to material supplied across three consignments. The claimant has sought settlement within a stipulated period, failing which it has indicated it will pursue recovery proceedings.

It is the second such notice reported against the company in the current financial year, according to a person in the local trade association.

Arcline Inds. could not be reached for comment.

headline: Lenders said to be reviewing exposure to Arcline Fabricators Limited
body:
At least two lenders to Arcline Fabricators Limited have initiated a review of their exposure to the Nagpur-based Steel Fabrication company, people aware of the discussions said.

The review follows what one of the people described as irregularity in servicing of working capital facilities during the last quarter. No formal classification has been made, and the account remains standard on the books of both lenders.

A banker involved said the company had sought an enhancement of its cash credit limit earlier in the year, which was not sanctioned in full.

Arcline Fabricators Limited did not respond to queries.

headline: Contractor serves recovery notice on Arcline Media Pvt Ltd
body:
A production contractor has served a recovery notice on Arcline Media Pvt Ltd over unpaid invoices relating to campaign work commissioned last year.

The Mumbai-based advertising and content agency said the amount was disputed and that it had responded through its counsel. The agency employs about ninety people and works largely with consumer brands.
